summary: Rigid-body inertia/rotation helper. Converts the Euler angles passed in a2 to a 3x3 rotation matrix via EulerAnglesTo33RotationMatrix, then transforms the inertia tensor to world space via F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform(this). Finally computes three dot products: each row of the transformed inertia tensor (this+0xEC/0xF4/0xFC, this+0x104/0x10C/0x114, this+0x11C/0x124/0x12C) dotted with the angular-velocity vector at this+0x94/0x9C/0xA4, storing the three scalar results as doubles at this+0x7C, this+0x84 and this+0x8C. Returns the F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform result. Called from seven physics/setup paths (PhysicsStateVectorConversion, sub_438F00, VehiclePhysicsInitializer, sub_43C250, FloatDoubleCoordinateTransform, VehiclePhysicsJointSystemLoader, sub_56F100).

operations.description: EulerAnglesTo33RotationMatrix(a2) converts the Euler-angle argument into the object's 3x3 rotation matrix before the tensor transform.
F_3x3InertiaTensorTransform(this) rotates the inertia tensor into world space; its return value is captured as the function result.
Output X (double this+0x7C) = this+0xFC * this+0xA4 + this+0xF4 * this+0x9C + this+0xEC * this+0x94 (row 0 of the transformed inertia tensor dotted with the angular velocity).
Output Y (double this+0x84) = this+0x114 * this+0xA4 + this+0x10C * this+0x9C + this+0x104 * this+0x94 (row 1 of the transformed inertia tensor dotted with the angular velocity).
Output Z (double this+0x8C) = this+0x12C * this+0xA4 + this+0x124 * this+0x9C + this+0x11C * this+0x94 (row 2 of the transformed inertia tensor dotted with the angular velocity).

unresolved: All tensor/velocity accesses are 8-byte doubles, so each enumerated offset is the low dword of a double pair spanning the next four bytes; the high dwords are not individually enumerated in the packet field list.
The naming of the output (torque vs force) and the exact physical meaning of a2's Euler angles are DERIVED from the fills, not proven by the .c.
